about: The heading of a reading from the Epistles of Saint Paul to the Corinthians. It does not number the letter, and the 1962 Roman Missal prints it over readings from both. Among them are the Epistles of Septuagesima and Sexagesima Sundays, of the First Sunday of Lent, of Easter Sunday and of the feast of Corpus Christi.

s01.translation: A reading from the Epistle of blessed Paul the Apostle to the Corinthians
